page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance delivers 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration that ensures dedicated CPU allocation without hyper-threading.

This instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers high resource density for workloads requiring massive parallel processing and substantial memory capacity without the overhead of hyper-threading. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, making it less suitable for local-storage-heavy databases or hardware-accelerated machine learning tasks.

The hardware profile makes this instance well-suited for large-scale general-purpose workloads, enterprise applications, high-concurrency web serving, distributed caching, and memory-intensive processing tasks that benefit from dedicated physical CPU cores and a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio.
